description: This file contains unit tests for the WorkScheduleService class in the OrangeHRM project, testing various scenarios such as class not defined, class not found, invalid class implementation, constructor exceptions, and successful retrieval of a valid work schedule implementation.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClass
classes.description: A dummy class used to test invalid class implementation scenarios.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClassExceptionInConstructor
classes.description: A dummy class that throws an exception during instantiation to test constructor failure handling.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleValidClass
classes.description: A mock implementation of WorkScheduleInterface used for testing successful retrieval and functionality within the test suite.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleNotDefined
methods.description: Tests behavior when the work schedule class is not defined (returns null).

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassNotFound
methods.description: Tests behavior when the specified work schedule class cannot be loaded (throws ConfigurationException).

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleInvalidClass
methods.description: Tests behavior when the loaded class does not implement the expected interface (throws ConfigurationException).

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassExceptionInConstructor
methods.description: Tests behavior when the class constructor throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetWorkSchedule
methods.description: Verifies successful retrieval of a valid work schedule implementation.
